label: Ancient Mirejaw phase transition

purpose.value: The realization lands — "You understand every word I say, don't you?" — and the guardian stops reasoning with the hero and starts containing him.

emotionalProgression.note: Every plea was understood. None of it mattered.
The guardian grieves that words have failed.
Reasoning ends; containment of the intruder begins.

notes: The pivotal line is the guardian realizing the amulet translates perfectly and the hero CHOSE to keep swinging. Keep it short: the turn from appeal to containment. Flavor: the spawning pools. DEVIATION: fact_amulet_translation_is_accurate sits in Mirejaw's unknown list, but the scene must convey it; it is demonstrated by the hero's comprehension, not recited by Mirejaw, so it is required here and omitted from forbiddenRevelations.
